hooks.name: Rerun golden fixtures when engine or rule code changes
hooks.description: After the agent saves engine source, an app adapter or a fixture, rerun the golden and review-regression fixture tests for both apps. CI remains authoritative.

action.command: npx vitest run apps/scopecheck/src/golden.test.ts apps/scopecheck/src/review-fixes.test.ts apps/packcheck/src/golden.test.ts apps/packcheck/src/review-fixes.test.ts
